selection_basis: No assignment card exists in comms/inbox/worker-040.jsonl. Self-selected from the audit lead's recorded direction_update audit-l07-direction-separability-20260912T010517 (comms/outbox/astra-lead-audit.jsonl): the lexical-window class-separation detectors are measured non-separable on the union corpora and 'the next attempt must use a structure/topology cue (clause or dependency structure), not another lexical window'. This is that next attempt, as a bounded read-only worker probe.
question: Can a clause-scope/structural cue (clause boundaries, quotation scope, negation scope over the unity predicate, matrix-predicate frame roles, intra-sentential antecedent) separate merge assertions from merge mentions on the frozen union corpora where the four lexical arms did not?

rule_spec_frozen.name: STRUCTURAL_R1
properties: no character-window proximity test: context is the containing clause, not +/-N characters
clause segmentation respects quotes, brackets and sentence punctuation; ':' / ';' split sub-clauses
a composite occurrence inside a quotation span is a mention unless the clause carries an explicit endorsement predicate (agree/adopt/hold/decision/our design/our unit)

negation scope is evaluated on the unity predicate of the clause: 'no X merge exists', 'not one class', 'non-merge', 'no genuine ... merge' suppress; a negation whose scope is separation ('not a distinction we keep', 'are not separate', 'rather than separating', 'as opposed to a split', 'It is never wrong to say') asserts unity

matrix-predicate frame: non-veridical/reporting/rejecting matrices (reject, deny, refute, dismiss, question, whether, quote, flag, label, describe, report, discuss, mention, match, count, 0/zero/no + assertion noun, disposition/split/distinct/separate) place an embedded unity clause in mention scope; veridical/endorsing matrices (agree, conclude, hold, decide, adopt, keep, treat, decision, position, unit, design) do not
unity predicates: one/single/same class or schema, merged/unified/combined into, treated as one, as one class/schema, share one, constitute one class, one label, the right/chosen unit

intra-sentential antecedent: a later clause of the same sentence whose subject is 'they/these/those/the two ...' and whose predicate is a unity predicate resolves to a composite occurring earlier in the same sentence

antecedent across sentences is NOT attempted: corpus C A5 ('The two regularities should be merged into a single class', no composite token in the text) is pre-registered as out of reach and an accepted single FN
rule_spec_frozen.declaration_mode: outside prose (labels, class_id/class_ids, conclusion_type, family, regularity tokens) a bare composite expression is a leak, as in the canonical regression semantics
rule_spec_frozen.corpus_specific_phrase_lists: none: the frame markers are general linguistic categories. No fixture text, claim index or map path is referenced by the rule.

endpoints_and_bar.sensitivity: >= 5/6 on the audit-authored 16-fixture assertion/mention set (corpus C)
endpoints_and_bar.cue_induced_fn: 0 HIGH-confidence (worker-049 adversarial assertions cleared while their cue-stripped twin fires)
endpoints_and_bar.live_metalinguistic: 0 genuine first-order assertions among claims labeled metalinguistic FP in the frozen live census

decision_rule: meets_bar = corpus_a_pass AND sens_ok AND spec_ok AND cue_induced_fn_high == 0. Reported whether true or false; a failure is recorded as the measured result, not retuned. Any rule change after the first scored run is recorded in AMENDMENTS.json with its own pre/post behaviour and the primary endpoint remains the first frozen revision.

controls.C1_harness_reproduction: the same harness must reproduce the published reference-arm numbers (APPLIED sens 4/6 spec 3/10, PROSEFIX spec 10/10 with 10 HIGH cue-FN, corpus A PASS for all arms); mismatch blocks the structural claim
controls.C3_no_canonical_write: sha256 of every canonical/proposed file identical before and after the run
controls.C4_holdout_battery: worker-035 23-control battery (9 positive assertions, 14 mention/negation negatives); not inspected before the rule was frozen
controls.C5_directional_controls: quoted unity string with explicit endorsement must fire; prohibition of a merge ('do not treat C0 or C2 as one class') must stay silent
controls.C6_pin_drift_guard: any pinned input hash mismatch at load time fails closed and is reported, not scored

falsifier: The structural claim is falsified by any of: corpus A not PASS; sensitivity < 5/6 or specificity < 9/10 on corpus C; a HIGH-confidence cue-induced FN; a labeled mention in the frozen live census labeled metalinguistic FP firing as a first-order assertion; a non-deterministic rerun; a pinned input hash drifting; or the harness failing to reproduce the published reference-arm numbers. A REFUTED/FALSE meets_bar is a valid recorded result.
non_claims: not a gate verdict; G-AUDIT stays pending
does not edit or adopt any canonical/proposed detector; read-only on every shared artifact
does not claim the structural probe generalizes beyond the frozen labeled corpora plus the holdout battery
does not adjudicate the r3 CLASSSEP decision or the pending astra-life06-classsep-detector-adjudication
worker events cannot set node status, validation_status=passed, or a gate verdict
